body.name: Empirical-mass correction of the exact occupancy pilot
body.construction: For \(n\ge8\), compute exactly the \(\widetilde\tau\) in \(\mathrm{def:occupancy\text{-}pilot}\) on the first \(m_0\) records. On the remaining \(m_1\) records form the guarded correction-block quantities and set \[\widehat\tau^{\mathrm{em}}:=\operatorname{clip}_{[-M,M]}\!\left[\widetilde\tau+\frac1{m_1}\sum_{k=1}^dN_k^{(1)}J_k^{(1)}\{\overline Y_{1k}^{(1)}-\overline Y_{0k}^{(1)}-\widetilde\tau\}\right].\] An empty or entirely unmatched correction block returns \(\widetilde\tau\), while empty and one-arm-only correction cells contribute zero. For \(3\le n<8\), set \(\widehat\tau^{\mathrm{em}}:=0\).
